title: tinospora esiangkara

The health benefits of Tinospora esiangkara include its potential use in treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and malaria, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Tinospora esiangkara include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
